# DIVERSITY

# 1. Color Sets

```{r}
# using " unique(S_metadata$FruitType)" 
color_FruitType <- c("BL" = "purple4", "CH" = "red4", "ST" = "red2")
color_FruitType2 <- c("CH" = "red4", "ST" = "red2")

# using cold colors for batch 1 sites, warm for batch 2
color_FruitVariety <- c("CDP" = "indianred", "HED" ="indianred1", "SUM" = "indianred4", "STA"="#CD2626", "SWE" = "firebrick1", "CIF" = "gold", "CIR" = "gold2", "DRE" = "lightgoldenrod1", "INF" = "yellow2", "MDB" = "yellow", "UNK" = "skyblue", "LOC"= "deepskyblue")

color_FruitSiteTypeVariety <- c("THU_BL_LOC" = "deepskyblue","THU_BL_UNK"="skyblue", "VAR_BL_LOC" = "dodgerblue", "THU_CH_HED"="indianred1", "THU_CH_SWE"= "firebrick1", "THU_ST_CIR"= "gold2", "THU_ST_MDB"= "yellow", "FIN_CH_CDP"= "indianred", "FIN_CH_SUM"="indianred4","LOM_CH_CDP"= "firebrick3", "LOM_CH_STA"="#CD2626","IST_ST_CIF"= "gold","IST_ST_DRE"= "lightgoldenrod3", "MIL_ST_INF"= "yellow2", "MIL_ST_MDB"= "khaki1")

color_Expe <- c("Fruits_0days"="darkolivegreen3", "Mothers_2days"="red3", "Fruits_5_6days"="darkolivegreen", "Larvae"="#8B4500", "Pupae"= "darkorange2",           "Daughters"="goldenrod2")
```

# 2. Load data

```{r}
# D1 expe
ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- Charge_xl_to_ps("ps_16S_rare_expe_D1", folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"))

# Filter data (exclude mothers 0days)
ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, SampleType %in%  c("Fruits_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Fruits_5_6days","Larvae","Pupae" ,"Daughters"))

ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1 <- Charge_xl_to_ps("ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1", folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"))

# Filter data (exclude mothers 0days)
ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, SampleType %in%  c("Fruits_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Fruits_5_6days","Larvae","Pupae" ,"Daughters"))

## Export
Save_ps_as_xls(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "4_Diversities")) 
Save_ps_as_xls(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "4_Diversities"))


# D2
ps_16S_rare_D2 <- Charge_xl_to_ps("ps_rare_16S_Dataset_2", folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_2"))
ps_ITS_rare_D2 <- Charge_xl_to_ps("ps_rare_ITS_Dataset_2", folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_2"))

metadata <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "TM123_metadata.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE) 
```

```{r}

ObsRich_ST_FT_16S$data$SampleType <- factor(ObsRich_ST_FT_16S$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")) # reorder 


Chao1_ST_FT_16S <- plot_AlphaDiv_index_groups(metadata_AlphaDiv_16S_d1, "SampleType",  c("Mothers_0days", "Fruits_0days", "Mothers_2days",  "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days" , "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters"), "Chao1" ,color_FruitType, "FruitType")

Chao1_ST_FT_16S$data$SampleType <- factor(Chao1_ST_FT_16S$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")) # reorder 



## ITS
Sha_ST_FT_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index_groups(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_d1, "SampleType",  c("Mothers_0days", "Fruits_0days", "Mothers_2days",  "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days" , "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters"), "Shannon" ,color_FruitType, "FruitType")

Sha_ST_FT_ITS$data$SampleType <- factor(Sha_ST_FT_ITS$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")) # reorder 


ObsRich_ST_FT_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index_groups(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_d1, "SampleType",  c("Mothers_0days", "Fruits_0days", "Mothers_2days",  "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days" , "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters"), "ObservedRichness" ,color_FruitType, "FruitType")

ObsRich_ST_FT_ITS$data$SampleType <- factor(ObsRich_ST_FT_ITS$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")) # reorder 


Chao1_ST_FT_ITS <- plot_AlphaDiv_index_groups(metadata_AlphaDiv_ITS_d1, "SampleType",  c("Mothers_0days", "Fruits_0days", "Mothers_2days",  "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days" , "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters"), "Chao1" ,color_FruitType, "FruitType")

Chao1_ST_FT_ITS$data$SampleType <- factor(Chao1_ST_FT_ITS$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")) # reorder 



## Figure 2 : combine + no InvSimp + color by Fruit
F3_2_16S <- (ObsRich_ST_FT_16S + Chao1_ST_FT_16S + Sha_ST_FT_16S) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()) & theme(legend.position = "none")

F3_2_ITS <- (ObsRich_ST_FT_ITS + Chao1_ST_FT_ITS + Sha_ST_FT_ITS) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect", axes = "collect_x", axis_titles = "collect_x") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

label_A <- wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob("A. BACTERIA", gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"), x = 0, hjust = 0))
label_B <- wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob("B. FUNGI", gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"), x = 0, hjust = 0))

# Final plot
F3_2_combined <- (label_A / F3_2_16S / label_B / F3_2_ITS) + plot_layout(heights = c(0.05, 1, 0.05, 1),ncol = 1) 

title_plot <- "AlphaDiv_Expe_SampleType_FruitType2_F60.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", "Dataset_1", title_plot), F3_2_combined, base_height = 29.7/cm(1),base_width = 42/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

# 4. Beta div. (NMDS)

## D1

```{r}
## Fruit Type x Sample Type NMDS
## Qualitative (Jaccard index)

ordi_nmds_J_16S_expe_D1 <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, method ="NMDS", distance ="jaccard") # stress = 0.1042477 

# plot with ellipses
NMDS_J_16S_expe_Ellipses <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(physeq = ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, ordination = ordi_nmds_J_16S_expe_D1) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = SampleType, shape = FruitType), size = 4) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(BL = 21, CH = 22, ST = 24, na = 23)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_Expe) + 
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = SampleType, color = SampleType), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = color_Expe) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Sample Type", ncol = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Fruit Type"), 
    color = "none")+ annotate("text", x = -3.8, y = 5.6, label = "A. Bacteria", hjust = 0, size = 6, fontface = "bold")

NMDS_J_16S_expe_Ellipses$data$SampleType <- factor(NMDS_J_16S_expe_Ellipses$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days","Mothers_2days",  "Larvae", "Pupae", "Daughters"))

title_plot <- "NMDS_16S_Expe_D1_FruitType_F60.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", "Dataset_1", title_plot), NMDS_J_16S_expe_Ellipses, base_height = 20/cm(1), base_width = 20/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

 
 
# ITS
 
ordi_nmds_J_ITS_expe_D1 <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, method ="NMDS", distance ="jaccard") # 0.1616465 

# plot ITS with ellipses by Fruit Type
NMDS_J_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(physeq = ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, ordination = ordi_nmds_J_ITS_expe_D1) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = SampleType, shape = FruitType), size = 4) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(BL = 21, CH = 22, ST = 24, na = 23)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_Expe) + 
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = FruitType), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.20, level = 0.95) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = color_Expe) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Sample Type", ncol = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Fruit Type"),
    color = "none") + annotate("text", x = -3.6, y = 2.1, label = "B. Fungi", hjust = 0, size = 6, fontface = "bold")

NMDS_J_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit$data$SampleType <- factor(NMDS_J_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days","Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_2days",  "Larvae", "Pupae", "Daughters"))

title_plot <- "NMDS_ITS_Expe_D1_SampleType_EllipseByFruit_F60.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_diversities", "Dataset_1", title_plot), NMDS_J_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit, base_height = 20/cm(1), base_width = 20/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
 
# Combined plot
NMDS_combined_F <- (NMDS_J_16S_expe_Ellipses|NMDS_J_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit) + plot_layout(ncol = 2,  widths = c(1, 1),guides = "collect") &  theme(legend.position = "right")

title_plot <- "NMDS_Expe_D1_SampleType_combined_F60.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", "Dataset_1", title_plot), NMDS_combined_F, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 34/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

```{r}
## Quantitative : BRAY-CURTIS INDEX

## Fruit Type x Sample Type NMDS

ordi_nmds_B_16S_expe_D1 <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, method ="NMDS", distance ="bray") # stress = 0.1042379 

# plot with ellipses
NMDS_BC_16S_expe_Ellipses <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(physeq = ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, ordination = ordi_nmds_B_16S_expe_D1) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_point(aes(fill = SampleType, shape = FruitType), size = 4) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(BL = 21, CH = 22, ST = 24, na = 23)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_Expe) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = SampleType, color = SampleType), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_Expe) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Sample Type", ncol = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Fruit Type"),
    color = "none")+ annotate("text", x = -3.3, y = 4.2, label = "A. Bacteria", hjust = 0, size = 6, fontface = "bold")

NMDS_BC_16S_expe_Ellipses$data$SampleType <- factor(NMDS_BC_16S_expe_Ellipses$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days","Mothers_2days",  "Larvae", "Pupae", "Daughters"))

title_plot <- "NMDS_BC_16S_Expe_D1_FruitType_F60.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", "Dataset_1", title_plot), NMDS_BC_16S_expe_Ellipses, base_height = 20/cm(1), base_width = 20/cm(1), dpi = 1200)


## ITS 
ordi_nmds_B_ITS_expe_D1 <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, method ="NMDS", distance ="bray") # stress = 0.1630403
 
# plot with ellipses by Fruit Type
NMDS_B_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(physeq = ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, ordination = ordi_nmds_B_ITS_expe_D1) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_point(aes(fill = SampleType, shape = FruitType), size = 4) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(BL = 21, CH = 22, ST = 24, na = 23)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_Expe) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = FruitType), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, level = 0.95) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_Expe) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, linetype = NULL, size = 5), title = "Sample Type", ncol = 1), shape = guide_legend(title = "Fruit Type"),
    color = "none") + annotate("text", x = -2.5, y = 1.8, label = "B. Fungi", hjust = 0, size = 6, fontface = "bold")

NMDS_B_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit$data$SampleType <- factor(NMDS_B_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "Daughters"))

title_plot <- "NMDS_BC_ITS_Expe_SampleType_EllipseByFruit_F60.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_diversities", "Dataset_1", title_plot), NMDS_B_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit, base_height = 20/cm(1), base_width = 20/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
 
# Combined plot
NMDS_BC_D1_combined <- (NMDS_BC_16S_expe_Ellipses + theme(legend.position = "none") |NMDS_B_ITS_SampleType_EllipsesByFruit + theme(legend.position = "right")) + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 1))

title_plot <- "NMDS_BC_D1_combined_F60.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "4_Diversities", "Dataset_1", title_plot), NMDS_BC_D1_combined, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 34/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```
